_om: Planeten in English: Orby. British English; key = the Norwegian text (rusj/SPRAK.md).
Slipp planeter ned i glasset. Når to lik: Drop planets into the jar. When two alike planets touch, they melt together into the next, bigger planet.
Dra fingeren til siden, eller bruk pilta: Slide your finger sideways, or use the arrow keys. The dotted line shows where the planet will land.
Slipp fingeren – eller trykk på mellomro: Lift your finger – or press space – and the planet falls.
To like blir én større: asteroide, månen: Two alike make one bigger: asteroid, Moon, Mercury, Mars, Venus, Earth, Neptune, Uranus, Saturn, Jupiter – and at last the Sun.
Blir noe liggende over den stiplede stre: If anything stays above the dashed line for a few seconds, the jar is full and the game is over.
Se på «Neste» øverst, så kan du planlegg: Keep an eye on ‘Next’ at the top, so you can plan where the next planet goes.
Samle de store planetene i ett hjørne, o: Keep the big planets together in one corner, and build towards them.
To soler blir en supernova – og masse po: Two suns make a supernova – and lots of points.
Planetene kommer i riktig rekkefølge ett: The planets come in their real order by size: Mercury is the smallest planet, Jupiter the biggest.
Spillet tar pause av seg selv hvis du by: The game pauses by itself if you switch apps. On a keyboard, P or Esc pauses.
Planeten går i sanntid og kan dessverre: Orby runs in real time and sadly can't be played with a screen reader.
Two alike planets make one bigger.
Dra for å sikte – slipp, så faller plane: Drag to aim – let go to drop.
Piltaster sikter · mellomrom slipper · P: Arrow keys aim · space drops · P = pause
A new personal best! The last one: {n}.
Første runde – nå har du en rekord å slå: Your first round – now you have a score to beat!
Try again – the jar is empty and ready.
